shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

Deep Purple Geode Fragment
Natural Mineral Specimen, 3.47 Pounds

A classic geological specimen, amethyst is prized by collectors for its vibrant coloration and unique crystalline formations, often used as a centerpiece for home decor or within mineral collections for its aesthetic and geological interest.
Numerous natural crystal terminations with characteristic hexagonal faceting
Deep purple saturation with translucent to semi-opaque clarity across the points
Natural rocky matrix base providing a stable foundation for upright display
Substantial size with a verified weight of 3.47 pounds
Condition:

The underside displays the raw, unpolished host rock matrix typical of geode extractions. Natural mineral inclusions and slight surface dust consistent with storage are present.

Emblems are intact and well-defined.

title: Vintage German Hunter Pipe Munchen Modular Wood Tobacco Pipe with Metal Lid
description:
German Hunter Style Tobacco Pipe
Munchen Edition, Modular Construction
Wood, Metal, and Horn, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A classic German "Jager" or hunter-style tobacco pipe, featuring the traditional modular multi-piece construction characteristic of Central European alpine regions. This specific piece is detailed with "Munchen" (Munich) engraved on the bowl, identifying it as a regional piece from the Bavarian capital. Designed for functionality in outdoor settings, these pipes feature long stems to cool the smoke and wind caps to protect the embers.
Modular design consisting of a polished wood bowl, bark-covered wooden stem section, and horn mouthpiece transition
Decorative hinged metal wind cap with ornate perforations and a secure latch mechanism
Accented with a traditional green cord featuring wooden toggle beads and a small decorative tassel
Engraved "Munchen" banner design on the side of the bowl
Condition:
The item is in used condition with visible charring and residue inside the bowl from previous use. The exterior wood finish retains a high gloss with minor surface handling marks. Metal components, including the bands and wind cap, show light tarnish and age-related patina. The modular joints fit securely. The green decorative cord is intact with some minor fraying to the tassel.

description:
2 Vintage Medico V.F.Q. Briar Wood Smoking Pipes Straight Stem Brown
This listing includes two vintage Medico V.F.Q. smoking pipes made from imported briar wood. Both pipes feature a classic straight-stem design with a brown natural wood finish and gold-colored band accents. The pipes exhibit visible signs of previous use such as surface wear and some discoloration but are structurally sound. Medico branding and 'V.F.Q. Imported Briar' markings are clearly visible on the shanks. These pipes are collectible mid-century pieces suitable for vintage tobacciana enthusiasts or pipe collectors.
